text:
matt_dev: Heads up — CI red on main, pre-commit linting failing in the rustfmt step. Seeing this on the latest merge from feature/kv-cache. Anyone else?
sana_qa: yep saw it. failing on import order in crate inference-runtime. Only on ubuntu-latest runners.
eli_ci: Repro locally with `docker run --rm -v $PWD:/work -w /work rust:1.70 bash -c 'cargo fmt -- --check'` — I get a diff.
jenna_sre: Is this the pre-commit hook or CI runner? format-bot also posted a fix earlier?
format-bot: format-bot: auto-scan found 1 file reordering imports in inference-runtime/src/serve/mod.rs
matt_dev: But pre-commit run locally passes for me. Could be different rustfmt version between CI and dev machines. In CI logs it shows rustfmt 1.5.0, local is 1.4.37.
sana_qa: That mismatch explains it. Should we pin rustfmt in the pre-commit config? cc @eli_ci
eli_ci: I can open a quick PR to pin toolchains in .pre-commit-config.yaml and add a `rust-toolchain` file. Alternatively we can change CI to use rustup + stable + `rustfmt --version` check.
matt_dev: @eli_ci please do the PR. Also can we rerun the failing workflow? /rerun in GH didn't pick up because it's a pre-commit check.
eli_ci: Kicked off a rerun after clearing the runner cache. If it still fails, I'll run `git bisect` — this looks like it started after commit 6f3a9b2 (import reorg by @sana_qa).
sana_qa: That commit touched a few modules. I can revert locally to verify. Quick note: I used `use crate::x::{a,b};` style.
jenna_sre: Quick triage checklist: 1) confirm rustfmt version mismatch 2) rerun CI 3) if still red, bisect 4) merge pin PR
format-bot: Suggestion: add `rustfmt.toml` with `reorder_imports = true` (if available) — but verify option exists for our rustfmt version.
eli_ci: Rerun finished — still failing. Starting bisect now, will report earliest bad commit.
matt_dev: :thumbsup: ping me when you have the culprit, I'll prepare the revert/patch.
eli_ci: Bisect found bad commit 6f3a9b2 — same as suspected. The change is reordering to a multiline group which older rustfmt versions format differently. Proposed fix: adjust code to satisfy both versions or pin.
sana_qa: Easy enough to adjust to stable style. I'll push a tiny formatting-safe change.
jenna_sre: Also file ticket to pin formatting toolchain in CI so this doesn't recur.
matt_dev: Nice work — once PR queued, I'll merge and un-block main. Thanks all :pray:
